package flowview

import (
	"bufio"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"codeflow/internal/evidence"
	"codeflow/internal/semantic"
)

// This test is compiled only by the disposable overlay. All observations use
// actual HTTP, history, and SSE. The bridge changes only filesystem failure
// timing inside the real transaction, not validation, authorization or commit.
func TestApprovalPublicPersistenceFaultsOverlay(t *testing.T) {
	for _, initial := range []string{"genesis", "active"} {
		for _, stage := range []string{"transaction-target", "transaction-event", "transaction-idempotency", "transaction-outbox", "transaction-before-commit"} {
			t.Run(initial+"/"+stage, func(t *testing.T) {
				srv, root, enrichment := newFlowViewApprovalProposalFixture(t)
				// Serve the actual production Handler over HTTP. This fixture
				// already published its scoped Q3 checkpoint synchronously. Starting
				// the unrelated compiler consumer would reprocess that fixture edit.
				network := httptest.NewServer(srv.httpServer.Handler)
				defer network.Close()
				defer func() { _ = srv.httpServer.Close(); _ = srv.Shutdown(context.Background()) }()
				ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
				defer cancel()
				endpoint := func(path string) string {
					u, _ := url.Parse(network.URL)
					u.Path = path
					q := u.Query()
					q.Set("token", srv.AuthToken())
					u.RawQuery = q.Encode()
					return u.String()
				}
				type reply struct {
					Status int
					Body   []byte
					Err    error
				}
				post := func(body string) reply {
					req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint("/api/semantic/approve"), strings.NewReader(body))
					req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
					resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
					if err != nil {
						return reply{Err: err}
					}
					defer resp.Body.Close()
					data, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
					return reply{Status: resp.StatusCode, Body: data, Err: err}
				}
				readHistory := func() reply {
					u, _ := url.Parse(endpoint("/api/semantic/approval-history"))
					q := u.Query()
					q.Set("proposalId", enrichment.Proposal.ProposalID)
					q.Set("evidencePackId", enrichment.Pack.EvidencePackID)
					u.RawQuery = q.Encode()
					req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, u.String(), nil)
					resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
					if err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					defer resp.Body.Close()
					data, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
					if err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					return reply{Status: resp.StatusCode, Body: data}
				}
				openStream := func() (*bufio.Scanner, func()) {
					u, _ := url.Parse(endpoint("/api/workspace/stream"))
					q := u.Query()
					q.Set("lastEventId", "vs09-fault-head")
					u.RawQuery = q.Encode()
					req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, u.String(), nil)
					resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
					if err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					if resp.StatusCode != 200 {
						resp.Body.Close()
						t.Fatalf("SSE status=%d", resp.StatusCode)
					}
					return bufio.NewScanner(resp.Body), func() { resp.Body.Close() }
				}
				next := func(scanner *bufio.Scanner) semantic.EventEnvelope {
					for scanner.Scan() {
						line := scanner.Text()
						if !strings.HasPrefix(line, "data: ") {
							continue
						}
						var event semantic.EventEnvelope
						if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "data: ")), &event); err != nil {
							t.Fatal(err)
						}
						return event
					}
					t.Fatalf("SSE ended: %v", scanner.Err())
					return semantic.EventEnvelope{}
				}
				version := int64(0)
				state := "none"
				decision := "approve"
				var predecessor *string
				if initial == "active" {
					first := post(flowViewApprovalBody(enrichment, "fault-initial", "approve", false, ""))
					if first.Err != nil || first.Status != 200 {
						t.Fatalf("initial approval=%+v", first)
					}
					var committed semantic.ApprovalExecutionResult
					if err := json.Unmarshal(first.Body, &committed); err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					if committed.Receipt.Aggregate.Version != 1 || committed.Receipt.Outbox.DeliveryState != "published" {
						t.Fatal("initial approval not published")
					}
					version = 1
					state = "active"
					decision = "revoke"
					predecessor = &committed.Receipt.Event.ApprovalID
				}
				body := flowViewApprovalBodyValues("fault-command", enrichment.Proposal.ProposalID, enrichment.Pack.EvidencePackID, enrichment.Proposal.ComputedBasisID, enrichment.Proposal.GenerationID, 1, decision, "fault-key", version, state, predecessor)
				beforeHistory := readHistory()
				if (initial == "genesis" && beforeHistory.Status != 404) || (initial == "active" && beforeHistory.Status != 200) {
					t.Fatalf("prior history=%+v", beforeHistory)
				}
				transactions := semantic.NewApprovalTransactionStore(root, srv.engine)
				before, err := transactions.Snapshot(ctx)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				proofBefore, err := srv.storage.ReadValidatedActiveProofBundle()
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				stream, closeStream := openStream()
				defer closeStream()
				head := next(stream)
				observed := make(chan semantic.EventEnvelope, 4)
				streamError := make(chan error, 1)
				go func() {
					for stream.Scan() {
						line := stream.Text()
						if !strings.HasPrefix(line, "data: ") {
							continue
						}
						var event semantic.EventEnvelope
						if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "data: ")), &event); err != nil {
							streamError <- err
							return
						}
						select {
						case observed <- event:
						case <-ctx.Done():
							return
						}
					}
					streamError <- stream.Err()
				}()
				entered := make(chan struct{})
				release := make(chan struct{})
				var releaseOnce sync.Once
				defer releaseOnce.Do(func() { close(release) })
				semantic.VS09TestBuildSetApprovalFault(srv.approvalService, func(actual string) error {
					if actual != stage {
						return nil
					}
					close(entered)
					select {
					case <-release:
					case <-ctx.Done():
						return ctx.Err()
					}
					return errors.New("private persistence fault canary")
				})
				completed := make(chan reply, 1)
				go func() { completed <- post(body) }()
				select {
				case <-entered:
				case <-ctx.Done():
					t.Fatal("real approval did not reach persistence fault")
				}
				// Observe the already-established public subscription while the
				// real commit is held. A new snapshot_sync would legitimately wait
				// on the proof lock, so it cannot be the precommit observation.
				select {
				case event := <-observed:
					t.Fatalf("approval broadcast before atomic commit: %+v", event)
				case err := <-streamError:
					t.Fatalf("held SSE closed: %v", err)
				case <-time.After(75 * time.Millisecond):
				}
				releaseOnce.Do(func() { close(release) })
				var failed reply
				select {
				case failed = <-completed:
				case <-ctx.Done():
					t.Fatal("fault request did not finish")
				}
				if failed.Err != nil || failed.Status == 200 || !strings.Contains(string(failed.Body), `"code":"approval_unavailable"`) || strings.Contains(string(failed.Body), "canary") {
					t.Fatalf("unbounded fault response=%+v", failed)
				}
				semantic.VS09TestBuildSetApprovalFault(srv.approvalService, nil)
				after, err := transactions.Snapshot(ctx)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				afterHistory := readHistory()
				unchangedRows := reflect.DeepEqual(before, after)
				if initial == "genesis" {
					// An absent database Snapshot returns nil slices. A rollback
					// leaves an initialized empty database with empty slices. Both
					// must contain zero of every atomic record, not partial rows.
					unchangedRows = len(before.Events) == 0 && len(before.Aggregates) == 0 && len(before.IdempotencyResults) == 0 && len(before.Outbox) == 0 && len(after.Events) == 0 && len(after.Aggregates) == 0 && len(after.IdempotencyResults) == 0 && len(after.Outbox) == 0
				}
				if !unchangedRows || !reflect.DeepEqual(beforeHistory, afterHistory) {
					t.Fatalf("failed transaction exposed partial records or changed public prior history: before=%+v after=%+v historyBefore=%+v historyAfter=%+v", before, after, beforeHistory, afterHistory)
				}
				failedStream, closeFailed := openStream()
				failedHead := next(failedStream)
				closeFailed()
				if failedHead.EventID != head.EventID || failedHead.Sequence != head.Sequence {
					t.Fatal("failed transaction changed public stream head")
				}
				retry := post(body)
				if retry.Err != nil || retry.Status != 200 {
					t.Fatalf("same-key retry=%+v", retry)
				}
				var committed semantic.ApprovalExecutionResult
				if err := json.Unmarshal(retry.Body, &committed); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				wantState := "active"
				if initial == "active" {
					wantState = "revoked"
				}
				if committed.Receipt.Replayed || committed.Receipt.Aggregate.Version != version+1 || committed.Receipt.Aggregate.State != wantState {
					t.Fatalf("retry result=%+v", committed)
				}
				var broadcast semantic.EventEnvelope
				select {
				case broadcast = <-observed:
				case err := <-streamError:
					t.Fatalf("retry SSE closed: %v", err)
				case <-ctx.Done():
					t.Fatal("retry SSE missing")
				}
				if broadcast.EventType != "approval.updated" || broadcast.Sequence != head.Sequence+1 {
					t.Fatalf("retry broadcast=%+v", broadcast)
				}
				var delivery struct {
					ApprovalEvent semantic.ApprovalOutboxCommittedEventV1 `json:"approvalEvent"`
				}
				encoded, _ := json.Marshal(broadcast.Data)
				if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &delivery); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if !reflect.DeepEqual(delivery.ApprovalEvent, committed.Receipt.Outbox.CommittedEvent) {
					t.Fatal("broadcast did not bind the committed receipt")
				}
				publishedRows, err := transactions.Snapshot(ctx)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if len(publishedRows.Events) != int(version+1) || len(publishedRows.Aggregates) != 1 || len(publishedRows.IdempotencyResults) != int(version+1) || len(publishedRows.Outbox) != int(version+1) {
					t.Fatalf("broadcast lacked four atomic records: %+v", publishedRows)
				}
				replayed := post(body)
				if replayed.Err != nil || replayed.Status != 200 {
					t.Fatalf("exact replay=%+v", replayed)
				}
				var repeated semantic.ApprovalExecutionResult
				if err := json.Unmarshal(replayed.Body, &repeated); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if !repeated.Receipt.Replayed || !reflect.DeepEqual(repeated.Receipt.Event, committed.Receipt.Event) || !reflect.DeepEqual(repeated.Receipt.Outbox, committed.Receipt.Outbox) {
					t.Fatal("exact replay changed committed identity")
				}
				finalStream, closeFinal := openStream()
				finalHead := next(finalStream)
				closeFinal()
				if finalHead.EventID != broadcast.EventID || finalHead.Sequence != broadcast.Sequence {
					t.Fatalf("replay duplicated broadcast: approval=%+v finalHead=%+v", broadcast, finalHead)
				}
				finalHistory := readHistory()
				var history semantic.ApprovalHistoryResult
				if err := json.Unmarshal(finalHistory.Body, &history); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if history.Aggregate.Version != version+1 || history.Aggregate.State != wantState || len(history.Events) != int(version+1) {
					t.Fatalf("final public history=%+v", history)
				}
				proofAfter, err := srv.storage.ReadValidatedActiveProofBundle()
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if !reflect.DeepEqual(proofBefore, proofAfter) {
					t.Fatal("fault/retry changed canonical Q3 proof")
				}
				evidence.ObserveApproval(t, "codeflow/internal/flowview", []string{"VS09-A12", "VS09-A13"}, map[string]any{"before.transactions": before, "after.transactions": after, "published.transactions": publishedRows, "before.history": beforeHistory, "after.history": afterHistory, "final.history": history, "before.proof": proofBefore, "after.proof": proofAfter, "before.sse": head, "held.observation": map[string]any{"stage": stage, "noEnvelopeDuringHoldMillis": 75}, "failed.sse": failedHead, "after.sse": broadcast, "final.sse": finalHead, "failure": failed, "retry": retry, "replay": replayed})
			})
		}
	}
}
